manifest.release_scope: Original native foundation; full language conformance remains separate

scope.profile: Real GENERIC DSS driver, original-schema RPC and original native listener/context/executor; catalog-backed TMparam injection and live binary TM.POWER.BUS_VOLTAGE telemetry.
scope.definition: Named GENERIC limit definitions are authoritative; the historical flat HARDSOFT projection remains compatible. This report verifies the original 79-check regression and its existing bounded claims.
limitations: Whole GetLimits/SetLimits, additional definition types, activation algorithms, hysteresis, alarm controls and registered files require the separate 64-case limit_full_report proof.
The original generic-value protobuf represents integers as signed Int64; out-of-range integers must reject before effects.
Complete v0.5 acceptance and release qualification remain separate gates.
